quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Second Quarter Business Review deck: Computing segment revenue increased 84% YoY, driven mostly by greater shipment from the Server business, and Computing rose to 23% of Q2 2026 revenue (2Q2025: 13%); Communication fell to 52% after a double-digit YoY decline on weaker demand, Consumer 7%, Others 18%. Inventory (net) was NT$152,241 million at 2026/6/30 versus NT$81,235 million at 2025/12/31 and NT$80,020 million at 2025/6/30.
